snippet.title: Hozier & Jessie Buckley - Fairytale of New York (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Official music vide of 'Fairytale of New York' performed by Hozier & Jessie Buckley.

Listen to '20th Century Paddy - The Songs of Shane MacGowan' now: https://found.ee/20thcenturypaddy

Produced by @Mahogany

Producer: Mark Murdoch
Director: Marcus Rexford
Director of Photography: Alessandro Di Rosa
2nd Camera Op: Piero Cioffi
Gaffer: Tobias May
Spark: Sam Girdner
Sound Engineer: Marco Iavarone 
Editor: Marcus Rexford
Photographer: Jake Turney
RAK Studios: Tegan Nicholls, Isaac Allen


Lyrics:
It was Christmas Eve, babe
In the drunk tank
An old man said to me
"Won't see another one"
And then he sang a song
"The Rare Old Mountain Dew"
I turned my face away
And dreamed about you
Got on a lucky one
Came in eighteen-to-one
I've got a feeling
This year's for me and you
So happy Christmas
I love you, baby
I can see a better time
When all our dreams come true

They've got cars big as bars, they've got rivers of gold
But the wind goes right through you, it's no place for the old
When you first took my hand on a cold Christmas Eve
You promised me Broadway was waiting for me

You were handsome, you were pretty, queen of New York City
When the band finished playing, they howled out for more
Sinatra was swinging, all the drunks, they were singing
We kissed on a corner, then danced through the night

The boys of the NYPD choir were singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells were ringing out for Christmas Day

You're a bum, you're a punk, you're an old hag on junk
Lying there almost dead on a drip in that bed
You scumbag, you maggot, you cheap, lousy blaggard
Happy Christmas, your arse, I pray God it's our last

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

"I could have been someone", well, so could anyone
You took my dreams from me when I first found you
I kept them with me, babe, I put them with my own
Can't make it all alone, I've built my dreams around you

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out
And the bells are ringing out
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

#fairytaleofnewyork #hozier #jessiebuckley

snippet.title: [4K] Watch Starship's First DOUBLE CATCH!!!
snippet.description:
SpaceX is targeting Starship Flight 15 NET Friday, November 13, 2026 at 4:45 p.m. CT (22:45 UTC), with a 75-minute window. This will be the FIRST attempt to catch both stages of Starship, with Ship 42 and Booster 22, carrying 26 Starlink V3 satellites on a roughly 22.5-hour mission of about 14 orbits at around 275 km. 

Booster 22 will return to the tower for the first-ever catch of a V3 Super Heavy about 6.5 minutes after liftoff. 

If all goes well Ship 42 will come back to Starbase for the first-ever Ship catch around 3:17 p.m. CT on Saturday, which would make it the first fully recovered orbital rocket in history and a huge step toward rapid, full reuse. 

We will have a separate livestream for ship catch here - https://youtube.com/live/AQFrpZaOpcQ?feature=share

Want to know why Starship's V3 Booster only has 3 grid fins instead of 4? Watch this!! - https://youtu.be/suZNTDISXKw

snippet.title: Gatto | Official Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
this cat’s on his last life...

Set in the feline-run underbelly of Venice, Italy, Gatto releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

Previously announced voice cast members Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne and Enrico Casarosa (who also serves as director) are joined by Bianca Babaşa as Maja; Sherry Cola as Regina; John Turturro as Capitano Briganti; Rumen Sali Shopov as Papu Janko; Rhys Darby as Focaccia; Isabella Rossellini as Contessa; Natasia Demetriou as Caronte; Jamie Demetriou as Plague Doctor; Jason Schwartzman as Vivaldi; Saverio Raimondo as Ugo; Jason Mantzoukas as Rico; Matt Jones as Enzo; Austin Madison as Fishmonger; Beatrice Manfredi as Martinelli; Jesse Andrews as Bartolomeo; Tracey Ullman as Luisa; and Marco Calvani as Maestro Foscari.

The original score for “Gatto” is composed by Academy Award®-winner Dario Marianelli (“Atonement”). The score features violin compositions co-written and performed by renowned Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero (voiced by Mark Ruffalo) begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco (voiced by Laurence Fishburne), the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first. “Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” 

Additionally, “Loving Dory,” a new animated short from Disney and Pixar set in the world of “Finding Nemo,” will play in theaters ahead of “Gatto.” Ellen DeGeneres returns as the voice of Dory in the short, which follows the forgetful blue tang fish as she finds herself in a hapless “meet-cute” with a plastic bag. Mistaking it for a gentle jellyfish, she's moved by its curious nature and falls head-over-fins in love. But it doesn't take long for her new romantic entanglement to escalate from a little clingy to outright toxic – and in desperate need of intervention! The short is written and directed by Lou Hamou-Lhadj, produced by Mary Alice Drumm and executive produced by Academy Award® winners Pete Docter and Andrew Stanton.

“Gatto” and “Loving Dory” release exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

Won’t hang my head, won't plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

Nobody cares or knows you ‘til you’re just a body 
I fought I pulled away but you, you always saw me 
You’re bruised and bloody, and I’m trying to act softly  
Oh I’m … half alive 

Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive

snippet.title: Ray Gunn | Official Trailer #2 | Netflix
snippet.description:

snippet.title: Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026
snippet.description:
Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026



Daddy Yankee protagonizó uno de los momentos más memorables de los Latin GRAMMY 2026 con una presentación histórica en honor a su reconocimiento como Persona del Año. En un espectacular medley de diez canciones, El Big Boss recorrió los grandes éxitos que marcaron su trayectoria y transformaron la música global, acompañado por invitados especiales como Bizarrap, LL Cool J, Jay Wheeler, Fresh Montana, Bad Gyal, Feid y la superestrella india Diljit Dosanjh. Jay Wheeler interpretó “Ella Me Levantó”, mientras Fresh Montana se sumó a “Con Calma”. Desde “Dura”, “Despacito” y “Gasolina” hasta “POKITO”, su más reciente colaboración, la presentación conectó generaciones, culturas y mercados, reafirmando la vigencia de su legado y su influencia en la música mundial. Una noche que rindió homenaje a quien no solo hizo historia en el reggaetón, sino que continúa escribiendo su próximo capítulo

Leave you, leave you, leave you, leave you
Never, never, never, never

'Ever, ’ever, 'ever, 'ever

Now I’m O-T-dub on the V line

And my headphones bumping these slow songs
Thinking 'bout last week, let's rewind
Didn't mean what I said

Break my own heart with the thoughts in my head
Always tеll you I'm sorry, then do it again

Maybe sometimes I hate you, but I can't pretend I’ll

Leave you, leave you, leave you, leave
Never, never, never, never
Need you, need you, need you, need you
’Ever, 'ever, ’ever, 'ever

Never, never, never, never
Need you, need you, need you, need you (Need you)
'Ever, 'ever, ’ever, 'ever (Forever)

Your hand holdin' on to mine, so sweet
Stumblin' out of the box
When did it turn 4 a.m.?
Maybe it's too good to be
R-I-P, all my clothes off
Never want this night to end
Tell me you love me again and again

Roses are red (Again)
Tiffany's blue (Again)
Is it too soon to say (Yeah)
I think I love you?

Leave you, leave you, leave you, leave

'Ever, 'ever, 'ever, 'ever (Forever)

Never, never, never, never, need— (Never, never, never, never)

Break my own heart with the thoughts in my head

Why do we fight when we could touch instead?
Maybe sometimes I hate you, but I can't pretend I'll

#FLO #LeaveYou

snippet.title: Spiff Vs Skyrim - Ultra modded skyrim 100 days - Stream 6 #live
snippet.description:
WHAT ARE WE DOING: 
Playing Skyrim with 2000 Hardcore Mods making the game near impossible! The world will also end in 100 days and everytime I die that day counts down by 1. I have to beat this impossible skyrim challenge asap so of course I am going to try and make use of as many gameplay features, glitches and exploits as possible! 

SEO Nonsense
Welcome back to skyrim! Where today we set out on a second attempt of an impossible challenge! Can you beat the survive 100 days in skyrim hardcore challenge? The rules are simple, Legendary difficulty skyrim with survival modes. This is the hardest possible challenge skyrim can offer. You are effectively playing at 1 hp and almost anything will kill you and fail the run. Ontop of that in survival mode you must eat and sleep similarly to an indie survival game. You must also balance temperatures which in the cold northern lands of skyrim is rather impossible. To make things worse I am playing with over 2000 mods at the same time meaning the game is drastically more challenging than ever before! 
Today we are putting a few twists on the original concept by doing the entire run live!

So sit back and watch as the spiffing brit tests to see if Skyrim is a perfectly balanced game with no exploits or surviving 100 days of skyrim hardcore is a task that is simply too impossible for this pro exploiter!


So sit back and watch as the spiffing brit tests to see if Skyrim is a perfectly balanced game with no exploits or surviving 100 days of skyrim hardcore is a task that is simply too impossible for this pro exploiter!

What you have seen here today is part of a fantastic perfectly balanced gameplay series on youtube where I go from game to game and break them with wacky exploits to gain things like unlimited gold and infinite money all in a fantastic montage. If you enjoyed this then be sure to check out more. The style is similar to RT game and callmekevin in parts. A large influence on this series has come from Valefisk and The Killian Experience. Are you ready for the ultimate skyrim challenge? In this video, I will be attempting the 100 Day Skyrim Challenge - a perfect balance challenge where I will be attempting to survive 100 days in Hardcore Survival Mode! This challenge will be live for a period of 100 days, so be sure to tune in to see if I can survive 100 days in the harsh world of Skyrim!

General list of mods used can be found here although I have added a few extra that I do not recommend as they are unstable: https://next.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/collections/qdurkx?_gl=1*1my6c4f*_ga*MTI2Mzk0OTUyMy4xNjgyOTM5ODQz*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTY5NjYxNzUxMS41Ni4wLjE2OTY2MTc1MTEuMC4wLjA.&utm_source=copy&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=share_collection

snippet.title: GTA 6 Is 30fps, but We Still Have Questions - Next-Gen Console Watch
snippet.description: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week, Daemon, Ryan, and Nick take a look at Rockstar's somewhat surprising announcement that GTA 6 will be targeting 30 frames per second on all consoles—including the PS5 Pro. Many gamers, especially those who shelled out the extra bucks for the premium console, were more than a little annoyed that there won't be a 60fps or even 40fps performance mode on the Pro model. Considering the limitations of the Xbox Series X and the PS5 family, is this still acceptable in 2026? Should Rockstar have cut more corners to get 60 frames on the PS5 Pro? Plus we have some choice words from former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada about the Xbox Series S, and is Nintendo back in the graphics race following the success of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake?

snippet.title: Why GTA 6 might be the biggest 'entertainment event' of the year | The Global Story
snippet.description:
“This is the biggest entertainment release ever”, says the BBC’s technology reporter, Laura Cress. 
 
Like the 10 million people who have pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto 6 ahead of its launch on 19 November, Laura is excited to experience the ground-breaking graphics and new features - including the first female protagonist - of gaming’s biggest franchise.
 
Laura tells The Global Story’s Tristan Redman about GTA’s surprising roots - in a small studio in Dundee, Scotland - and explains how its nihilistic eye on the US cities the game is modelled on has courted controversy and raised political debate.

snippet.title: We Hunt Unknown Species With 2 New Recruits... It Was Complete Chaos!
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Species: Unknown full gameplay! I travel back to Stormrock with a couple of new recruits... w/ @OlafPawbelt & @CrunchySki 

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT SPECIES: UNKNOWN
Form a squad of up to 4 players to take on different contracts with escalating difficulty. Each mission plays differently depending on your objective, your teammates, the map and which of the 5 intelligent threats is stalking you. No one survives alone, but you can try. 
Every contract drops you into a different nightmare. Whether you're tasked with extracting a black box, capturing or eliminating an unknown threat, or even destroying the ship to prevent the creature from escaping… Each mission demands a specific strategy and none of them are easy.
The specimen is chosen procedurally from a growing roster of terrifying monsters. Each one comes with distinct behaviors, hunting patterns, strengths, and weaknesses. You’ll need to investigate your surroundings to gather vital clues and identify the threat in order to proceed smoothly (or not). Do your job and get rewarded, or die without anyone knowing.

Game Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747330/Species_Unknown/

I simulated 53 years of football history starting from 1973. See how the sport evolves from Pelé’s final years to modern legends.

This simulation uses a retro database to recreate the 1973-74 season, capturing the era when Ajax dominated the European Cup and Brian Clough led Derby County. We track the changing landscape of the game, including player profiles like Ballon d'Or winner François Calderaro and high-stakes match simulations between clubs like Real Madrid and Juventus.

By running a long-term football history save, we can observe how tactical shifts and historical figures alter the timeline of the sport. Whether you are interested in the legends of the past or the unpredictability of a full retro database, this video provides a unique look at how the world might have unfolded.
